lame.min.js is lamejs 1.2.1 (https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs), a JavaScript port of the LAME MP3 encoder
(https://lame.sourceforge.io). It is used unchanged, as a separate file, under the GNU LGPL.
The app only loads it when a recording has to be shrunk before it is sent.

The fonts in ../fonts are Barlow and Barlow Condensed (https://github.com/jpt/barlow), SIL Open Font License 1.1.
